name: Money
summary: Currency market bidding game where players trade sets of banknotes to build high-value currency portfolios.
rules_text: Players 3-5. Remove 1 currency for 4 players, 2 for 3 players. Each player gets a bluff card and 6 random banknotes/coins as a 7-card hand. 8 cards are dealt as two 4-card market displays left and right of the draw pile. Each round all players simultaneously choose any number of cards from hand as a bid; bluff cards are just to pad the count and return to hand upon reveal. Bid value is sum of printed values. Turn order is descending bid value, tie broken by lowest serial number in bid. In turn order each bidder may: 1) take all cards from one market display and replace it with his bid cards, 2) take another player's still-available bid and give him his own bid - the robbed player now moves next, or 3) take back his bid and do nothing. Non-bidders skip. After all bidders acted, refill each display to 4 from draw pile (right first). Repeat until draw pile empties; play final short round. Final scoring: per currency sum >=200 scores full value, <200 scores value-100 (min 0 overall). Each coin is 10. Each triplet of three 20s or three 30s of same currency gives +100. Highest total wins.
rating_reason: Currency auction with bluff cards, bidding and hidden information.
